reason: Self benchmark: the historical-commit evaluation applied to the public history of this repository. Freeze eligibility, chronological development/test assignment, preselected verification tasks and implementation before any scoring. Parent revisions are indexed before target changes; results guide no tuning.
hashing: SHA-256 of exact working-tree code/input bytes used for this evaluation. Private raw manifest is identified only by its digest.
eligibility: Inspect the 400 most recent reachable non-merge commits at each pinned HEAD; select recent eligible commits by committer timestamp and SHA. Require 1-8 existing changed source files at the parent, including deletions and parent paths of renames. New/copied files are omitted from gold. Reject unavailable parents, bots, source type changes, pure renames, conservative horizontal-whitespace-only and explicitly code-formatter-labelled changes. Ancillary non-source edits are allowed. Gold comes from the parent Git tree and is never reduced by what the index contains; gold files the index lacks count as misses. Source suffixes: kt,kts,java,gradle,xml,aidl,proto,sq,sql,c,cc,cpp,cxx,h,hpp. Statements remove changed source paths, basenames and PR numbers, preserving bare domain words. Older floor(n/2) tasks are DEV; the remainder are TEST per repository. Five verification slots are allocated round-robin by repository ID and evenly spaced chronologically within each repository before scoring. Per-repository limit=60. Verification=5/5.
tier1: Full strictly exceeds raw and English BM25 on localization recall@5/recall@10/NDCG@10 and context gold-context recall/token precision at every budget on each repository/split and pooled split.
tier2: Full versus lexical-only task-paired bootstrap; reported with significance, nonblocking.
